paper_title: Revised constraints and Belle II sensitivity for visible and invisible axion-like particles
suggested_experiment_name: SN 1987A + beam dump + collider ALP-photon constraints (Fig 2 left)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper presents Belle II projected sensitivity to ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (GeV^-1) vs ma (GeV) for both invisible (gamma+inv) and 3-photon channels, plus revised constraints from LEP, BaBar, beam dumps, SN1987A. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton. However all results are presented graphically (figures 4, 7) with no numerical tables or explicit tabulated (mass, coupling) values in the text, so no reliable data points can be extracted. Rough guide values mentioned in text: Belle II can probe g_agamma ~ 1e-4 GeV^-1 over wide mass range; SN1987A bound ~6e-9 GeV^-1 for small masses (energy-loss) and ~7e-6 GeV^-1 (trapping). These are not a coherent limit curve. Both projection (Belle II) and observed constraints present. | [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('envelope of overlapping exclusion regions') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 2 left panel (g_aZ=0).
